summary: Starts engine totals alongside project statistics when opening a verified workspace dashboard.
userImpact: Engine totals can appear sooner on reload. Project totals still display as soon as their own request finishes.
security: Both requests use the verified workspace session and its permission snapshot.
documentation: Release notes describe the independent dashboard loading behavior.
rollback: Redeploy the preceding compatible frontend image.
validation: Browser checks verify concurrent request start, independent project rendering, and reuse of the in-flight engine request.

customerDocumentation.reason: The update changes when the existing dashboard values arrive.
